status_rule: No stage is marked accepted from documentation, compile only, diagram, or successful independent narrow test. Record exact source commit, native test, CI run, real artifact and site-specific proof.

stages.title: Authority, scope and six-check preflight
stages.goal: Establish verified source ownership, recovery priority, task scope and preflight before edits.
implementation_tasks: Reconcile main SHA and the required recovery, installer, full multiplayer and native editor results; identify concurrent owners.
Record per-site canonical source paths, concept approvals, all 28 base locations and annex; distinguish Castle headquarters and playable missions.
Define six-check preflight: owner/scope, source hash, backup, dependencies, reversible operation, verification/review.
Do not infer installed/hardware acceptance from a package build or a documentation checkpoint.
acceptance_checks: Inventory at exact SHA; no content overwritten.
Recovery REC-01/02 blockers remain prominent.
Baseline fixture and owner-map register read back from repository.
risk_controls: Never force-push or retag.
No new CI workflows for design-only changes.

stages.title: Runtime scene capability broker
stages.goal: Unify typed operation discovery, revisions and scene authority without adding a second scene.
implementation_tasks: Define SceneDescriptor with site ID, scene ID, document codec/hash, source commit, runtime modules, allowed operations and unsupported reasons.
Route all planner commands through the same native host/service used by Swing and the CLI; never let model code call a free-form Runnable.
Make coordinate units/angles, stable IDs, scene revision, side effects and dependency invalidations explicit.
Keep serialized owner-thread commits and shared history; adapt per-site capability sets rather than advertising universal controls.
Constrain MCP/CLI authorization, target site, document root and revision; include immutable source fingerprints.
acceptance_checks: Castle and House human/headless/MCP equal-state readback.
Wrong owner, unsupported operation, stale revision and unauthorized scope fail without side effects.
Existing save/reopen and old document fixtures pass on Windows.
risk_controls: No parallel scene storage.
Use existing single-writer save lock and request idempotency.

stages.title: Mission prop parity and safe scene cloning
stages.goal: Expose existing human mission prop actions to the agent using stable IDs and protected attachments.
implementation_tasks: Implement place, duplicate, remove, transform XYZ/yaw/scale and approved mesh replace with native room/support/bounds validation.
Reuse human editor native mutation and transaction/history instead of an agent-specific props list.
Retain source-bound plumbing, fixtures and dependent controls; infer no support from a mesh name alone.
Support an explicitly scoped USER level cloned from an approved template without claiming empty-site construction.
Publish typed schema and actual GUI/headless/MCP parity tests with invalid-asset and protected-fixture negatives.
acceptance_checks: Mission objects can be placed, rotated, duplicated and deleted, saved/reopened/undone without changing others.
Attached kitchen/service geometry remains protected even under planner input.
Legacy House/USER BSCN compatibility retained.
risk_controls: No standalone edit of source-bound assemblies.
Site clones do not confer WLD-14 identity.

stages.title: Mission foundations, walls, floors, roofs and openings
stages.goal: Implement real structural authoring on a mission, not only Castle surfaces and loose objects.
implementation_tasks: Add typed foundation, thick-wall-run, joined-wall, floor-slab with underside, roof-shell and cut-aperture operations.
Support actual frame/sill/doorway/void geometry; no zero-thickness facade, alpha-only holes or route-only metadata.
Bind every geometry patch to the same rendered/collision/room/nav/portal/acoustic revisions, with scoped invalidation.
Use native IDs, metric coordinates, measured bounds, material/pivot references and capped batch complexity.
Implement atomic rollback of structural edits and correct both-direction raster/body checks.
acceptance_checks: Construct an enclosed new room in School or Farmhouse with physical aperture and real floor support.
Undo/save/reopen yields exactly matching geometry, render and standing collision.
Negative unsupported roof/opening/foundation edit leaves document identical.
risk_controls: Do not copy Castle surface JSON and call it mission construction.
Reject unsupported mesh and floating support.

stages.title: Multi-storey rooms, portals and circulation
stages.goal: Complete actual floor-to-floor access, named spaces and shared circulation/room ownership.
implementation_tasks: Author continuous stairs/landings/ramps, upper-floor cutouts, rail/guards and supported cellar transitions.
Model subordinate rooms and gameplay zones with stable ownership and meaningful privacy/service routes.
Derive nav, acoustic portals, optical visibility and door collision from the same physical room boundaries.
Run native swept capsule routes up/down and between all required rooms at standing and crouched height.
Expose stable portal/room IDs and diagnostic coordinates for blocked points.
acceptance_checks: A native two-level site can be traversed in both directions without penetrating floor slabs.
Doors open into real authored apertures and actual room identities agree in graphics/physics/nav.
Invalid headroom/landing or orphan portal fails visibly.
risk_controls: No disconnected graph-only stairs.
No arbitrary generic room coordinates substituted for physical geometry.

stages.title: Stitched terrain, caves, roads, water and boundaries
stages.goal: Bind existing human terrain modules to native agent commands and outdoor runtime/physics.
implementation_tasks: Expose safe height brush, seam, adaptive topology, terrain layer, cutout/cave and existing terrain-scene package operations through site-owned commands.
Ensure cross-tile joins are atomic and edited terrain support/visibility/body uses exact published triangle geometry.
Author graded foundations, roads, rails/bridges, shoreline/water interface, retaining slopes and permanent perimeters.
Maintain matching van parking elevation and extraction clearances after regrading.
Preserve source PNG/BLEND/GLB ownership and prevent generated preview assets from replacing native source.
Test real underpass/floor hole with body and optical passes across tile edges.
acceptance_checks: 3x3 native world sculpt/seam roundtrip with rollback and no cracks.
One outdoor site renders, collides and rays against the same modified terrain revision.
Van access, upper views and perimeter/horizon checks survive regrade.
risk_controls: No display-only 2D terrain claimed as playable.
Water and terrain cannot leak into enclosed interiors.

stages.title: Electrical, environmental and ghost-gameplay services
stages.goal: Expose native site services as typed components tied to geometry and real host gameplay.
implementation_tasks: Implement room-scoped light/switch/mount commands, remote generator and breaker/distribution ownership.
Attach actual ghost/hunter spawns, evidence/ritual locations, hiding sockets, cameras and canonical van equipment locations.
Bind audio volumes, openings/occlusion, weather/water and room circuits to physical revision owners.
Validate HidingBudget.MAXIMUM, accessible search envelope, AI/pursuit routes and ordinary site service functions.
Enforce host-authoritative gameplay, no independent physics AI/audio replica or fabricated encounter pass.
acceptance_checks: A native game room light and switch change affects exact in-game rendered lighting and real source state.
Generator trip/reset, evidence and ritual placement pass native and multiplayer checks.
Sealed geometry does not leak sound, weather/water or uncontrolled lighting after edit.
risk_controls: No auto-solved clues or replacement of existing ghost AI.
Do not invalidate full-world lighting for a local door change.

stages.title: Asset/prefab, model and material operations
stages.goal: Reuse approved model, texture, fixture and prefab workspaces through measured, reversible operations.
implementation_tasks: Expose approved palette and source manifest with license, exact bounds/pivot, support and material identifiers.
Add safe prefab/part assembly, replace-in-place, surface mount, drop-to-support and measured placement macros.
Bridge selected already-tested topology, UV and material operations to native agent API; do not give arbitrary Blender/script execution.
Apply deterministic bounded scatter and visual wear without altering shared original assets.
Use immutable version-pinned shared-library references while concurrent map tasks execute.
acceptance_checks: An approved GLB replacement retains geometry/material/UV/collision and survives native save/reopen.
A model agent cannot mutate the shared binary during concurrent scene edits.
Unsupported rig/UV transforms and missing original assets refuse safely.
risk_controls: No pasted generic collision box for all models.
No missing-source or unsafe-license material publication.

stages.title: Runtime verification, renderer proofs and defect evidence
stages.goal: Extend genuine native inspection to full geometry, gameplay and reproducible fixed-camera evidence.
implementation_tasks: Build targeted checks for support, exact wall/roof/portal containment, clipped objects, 3D capsule sweeps and source/collider parity.
Record stable camera, render mode, light/time/weather state, actual before/after PNG and changed geometry IDs.
Attach exact failed code, object/room ID, scene revision, coordinates and source hashes to defect ledger.
Distinguish visual/surface advisory issues from required build/launch/host/network/update release failures.
Verify scene across real renderer, physics, nav, rooms, acoustics and services before promotion.
acceptance_checks: A deliberately blocked stair, open roof or embedded lamp fails a real check; repair makes it pass.
Camera-mismatched or identical PNG alone never certifies a structural change.
Evidence bundle has source SHA, native document digest, receipts, PNGs, tests and unresolved issues.
risk_controls: Never weaken an assertion to turn CI green.
Do not claim physical GPU/FPS or installed acceptance from headless software render.

stages.title: Bounded multi-round agentic map iteration
stages.goal: Turn the single-choice Ollama test into staged observe–plan–edit–test–review–replan.
implementation_tasks: Compile typed site goals and S00–S11 work packages into dependencies and read-only context, filtered to host capabilities.
Let Ollama propose only listed native commands; trusted broker validates state, model output, ownership, budget and dependencies.
Apply bounded atomic batches, rerun actual tests, capture matching camera views and inspect physical diffs.
Checkpoint accepted rounds; replan on diagnosed failure, and stop on no progress or human approval requirement.
Track substantive physical work separately from tiny cosmetic edits, renamed metadata and screenshots.
acceptance_checks: One site completes at least three meaningful dependent edits and post-edit tests through the real editor.
Injected unsafe proposal, stale revision, and failed multi-command batch never persist partial edits.
A planner cannot execute shell commands or write GitHub directly.
risk_controls: Model is not granted arbitrary source-code execution.
One revision owner per iterative scene.

stages.title: Durable task journal, retry and checkpoint restoration
stages.goal: Preserve atomic task progress across crashes, runner restarts, unknown responses and resource interruptions.
implementation_tasks: Create versioned TaskEnvelope, dependency DAG, work item states, budgets and manifest-identity checks.
Persist task records, lease/snapshot metadata, edit sequence, request digest, source state and result hash on durable runner storage plus immutable artifact checkpoints.
On retry reconcile native saved scene and sequence receipts; never blindly replay uncertain non-idempotent mutations.
Bound model calls, retries, infer context size, worker memory, total rounds and execution time.
Prove interruption at before-commit, after-commit-before-response, after-save and during image upload.
acceptance_checks: All interrupted tasks resume without duplicate geometry or leaked scene ownership.
Bounded retries surface unresolvable conflicts, not infinite background loops.
Reviewable report links exact scene document, native transactions and evidence hashes.
risk_controls: Scheduled tasks are never silently disabled.
Runner artifacts cannot stand in for a verified canonical source revision.

stages.title: Concurrent site task allocation, worker leases and merge safety
stages.goal: Run at least two independent maps concurrently without concurrent writers to one native scene.
implementation_tasks: Allocate one owner process and fenced lease per scene; forbid stale lease writes even when native revision appears equal.
Schedule two isolated native site workers and a shared, bounded Ollama planning queue.
Pin shared asset catalog and source revision; shared model edits are dependency tasks with separate ownership.
Use durable task DAG with block/retry/review states, per-site receipts, workspace paths and artefact manifests.
Inject a stale writer, worker timeout and shared-asset conflict; only the affected task fails.
Reconcile upstream Git commits before any reviewed promotion; no automated force-push.
acceptance_checks: School and Farmhouse complete independently checkable multi-round real edits with distinct saved documents and captures.
Same-scene dual writer and expired lease cannot commit.
Failure/rollback of one task leaves the other map and shared library unchanged.
risk_controls: Never launch multiple workflows per task.
Do not run multiple CPU/GPU-heavy planners simultaneously on one constrained runner by default.

stages.title: First-class WLD-14/outdoor site adapter
stages.goal: Make Morrow Point Lightstation a native, runtime-linked editable site rather than a renamed template.
implementation_tasks: Identify existing WLD-14 editable Blender/GLB/HCS2/terrain source and its exact runtime loader/owner; preserve all originals.
Bind the actual site geometry and required services to a native editor adapter, saved scene and catalog identity.
Expose safe structural/terrain changes through existing CLI/MCP host, with real render/collider/room consistency.
Prove native save/reopen and the same changed location in the installed game, leaving any unintegrated systems catalog-locked.
Do not copy unchanged School or generic wing geometry and relabel it WLD-14.
acceptance_checks: Morrow Point opens by its own stable site ID with real authored model, terrain and native revision.
One bounded structural edit produces a saved native scene and matching runtime render/body change.
Game-site availability remains gated until whole-mission acceptance.
risk_controls: No fake placeholder mission unlock.
Existing map packets are planning until physically consumed by game.

stages.title: Lighthouse complete construction and visual/gameplay pilot
stages.goal: Supervise one start-to-finish true Lighthouse build across all site construction/acceptance stages.
implementation_tasks: Construct tower/lantern, keeper house/covered passage, generator/oil house, cistern, real coastal grading and bounded search zones.
Build genuine stairs, floors/voids, windows, access, room/portal, services, van/extraction and correct lighting/weather.
Iteratively furnish/age/author encounters using approved assets; preserve normal former function and approved story.
Run day/dusk/night fixed camera review, full body/optical/nav/hiding/ritual checks, installed case gameplay and TCP.
Publish exact source hashes, accepted construction diffs, rejected alternatives and human approval; retain max 40 accessible search spaces.
acceptance_checks: Real site structure and subsystems are committed through native editor and survive reopen.
Game mission starts and can progress through equipment, evidence, ritual and extraction under actual host/guest.
Human confirms legible layout/material and full-map status; before approval keep locked.
risk_controls: Not complete from design packets or 2D route study.
No promotional release from artwork-only acceptance.

stages.title: Full-roster staged production and metrics
stages.goal: Apply the proven pipeline to the existing 28 base plus annex, retaining blocked sites visibly.
implementation_tasks: Sync per-site S00–S11 status and evidence; Castle-first owner priority is preserved while other planning can proceed.
Allocate independent construction batches by map readiness, prerequisites, native system support and resource budgets.
Only count changed physical geometry and genuinely playable integrations; keep graphics/asset refinements separate.
Capture actual per-site tested source, scene, gallery evidence, unresolved defects and review records.
Measure validated edits/hour, retries, token/model budget, collisions, worker overlap and map stage throughput.
acceptance_checks: All 29 sites either show evidence-backed stage acceptance or explicit blockers; none silently omitted.
Per-site review links actual render/collision/nav/service progress, not reports or filenames.
Concurrent tasks do not clobber shared source models or native saved documents.
risk_controls: No automatic completion percentage from packet count.
No unrelated workflow proliferation.

stages.title: Controlled promotion, installed acceptance and operational handoff
stages.goal: Close only genuinely accepted maps and promote under existing recovery/release gates.
implementation_tasks: Review source diff, exact native document/scene/multiplayer/renderer/acoustics/AI parity and license/source provenance.
Run required game build, launch, updater, essential gameplay and TCP multiplayer tests; distinguish release blockers from advisory design checks.
Require human visual approval before map promotion and preserve existing saves/paths with migrations.
Push only reconciled authorized main changes, record commit SHA and artifact/gallery readback; never force-push or retag.
Provide supervisor stop/retry/intervention controls, failure receipts and cost/reproducibility dashboards.
acceptance_checks: Accepted site survives installed launch, real case, network, save/reopen and next launch as appropriate.
User-review result and exact source/artifact evidence accompany remote commit.
No unfinished map is presented as complete and no failed release gate bypassed.
risk_controls: No release claimed from a green editor test alone.
Do not silently overwrite installed or player-owned documents.
